_Requested by **Sam** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01LjZwNRFiG2fkp8SNf6rHNx?thread=cmsg_01LjZwNRFiG2fkp8SNf6rHNxLMqJ5bmbVZe3ZDYjzkrBBY)_
domain:devx#1 · os-zhuang · session_01QUs3BvP5Aq9USg5GtmgAAR
Fixes #25676

## What changes

- `pnpm-lock.yaml`: tedious 18.6.2 now resolves `@azure/identity` 4.14.1 (was 4.13.1), which brings `@azure/msal-node` 7.1.2 (was 5.4.1), `@azure/msal-browser` 5.27.0, `@azure/msal-common` 16.15.0, the new `@azure/core-process` 1.0.0, and moves identity's `open` from 10.2.0 to the 11.0.4 already in the tree (so `open@10.2.0` and `wsl-utils@0.1.0` leave). Nothing else in the resolved set moves.
- `pnpm-workspace.yaml`: the "NOT cleared: @azure/msal-node GHSA-xcx6-jx8p-x3h5" note in the overrides comment block is removed. No override entry is added or changed.

## Why

`@azure/identity` 4.14.1 (published 2026-10-29) declares `@azure/msal-node: ^7.1.0`, the first identity release that admits the GHSA-xcx6-jx8p-x3h5 fix. tedious 18.6.2 declares `@azure/identity: ^4.2.1`, so 4.14.1 sits inside its range: no tedious bump and no `pnpm.overrides` pin is needed. The path is driver-sql's optional mssql peer.

How the lockfile was moved (targeted, no full re-resolve): the identity, msal-browser, msal-common, msal-node and tedious entries were dropped from the lockfile and `pnpm install --lockfile-only --fix-lockfile` (pnpm 10.31.0) re-resolved just those. That run also stamped one unrelated registry `deprecated:` line onto `@smithy/core@3.29.5`; it was removed to keep the diff to this card. `pnpm install --lockfile-only --frozen-lockfile` then passes with no change.

## Verification

- `pnpm audit --prod --audit-level=high`: exit 0 on this branch (exit 1 on `main`). What is left in `--prod`: one moderate, minimatch GHSA-g3hv-75wg-m249, which already carries a dated OSV exemption on `main`.
- `pnpm install --lockfile-only --frozen-lockfile`: clean.
- `node scripts/check-commit-card-trailers.mjs --range origin/main..HEAD`: exit 0.
- `node scripts/check-osv-exemptions.mjs`: exit 0.
- Not measured locally: `pnpm check:override-consistency` refused with exit 3 because this container has no `node_modules`; no override changed, and CI runs it after install.
- No test in this workspace exercises the Azure AD sign-in path (the card records this); the move stays inside identity's and tedious's declared ranges.

No changeset: the diff touches only the lockfile and a workspace comment and publishes nothing from any released package.
